The U.S. International Trade Commission made final affirmative injury determinations for van-type trailer imports from China, and Commerce issued antidumping and countervailing duty orders covering those imports; investigations for Canada and Mexico remain pending with final determinations expected in December 2026 and early 2027.

Wise Group plc completed its dual listing, transferring its primary listing to Nasdaq on May 11, 2026, and became the ultimate parent company of Wise Limited (previously named Wise plc) on May 8, 2026 by means of a Scheme of Arrangement pursuant to Part 26 of the U.K. Companies Act 2006.
Xenia recorded $39,251 (table in thousands) in impairment and other losses during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $279 (table in thousands) in the same prior-year period.
Xenia completed the disposition of the 545-room Fairmont Dallas for a sale price of $111.0 million, resulting in a gain on sale of $40.0 million.
In July 2026, Xenia sold the 85-room Kimpton RiverPlace Hotel for $11 million, or approximately $129,400 per key.
